findings.title: Hardcoded list violates naming consistency and maintainability
findings.body: The new list items are hardcoded with literal strings (`lint`, `typecheck`, `test`) instead of using a constant or derived array. This duplicates the previous `CHECK_NAMES` constant and violates the custom rule **Naming Consistency** (point 1): the file previously used a single source of truth for the list, but now the same values are repeated inline, making future changes error-prone and inconsistent with the repository's pattern of centralizing such lists.

findings.title: Inline list items reduce maintainability and violate FSD layer boundaries
findings.body: The new implementation inlines the list items directly in JSX instead of mapping over a constant array. This makes the component harder to maintain and violates the **FSD Layer Boundaries** custom rule (point 4): the component file now mixes presentation with data, which is less idiomatic for shared components in this codebase. Centralizing the list in a constant aligns with the pattern used elsewhere in the repository.

summary.problem: The change hardcodes the list of checks inline, duplicating a previously centralized constant and reducing maintainability.
summary.done_well: The new JSX structure is clean and avoids the removed constant declaration, which was unused elsewhere.
